calibration_warning: Secondary output. The probability calibration was fitted on April-May 2009 (12.8% conversion) and, on the later test period (30.8% conversion), predicted 14.7% on average. Calibration drifts when the overall conversion rate changes; it needs recent outcome data before these probabilities can be relied on. Use the priority band and ranking percentile for decisions.
model: Logistic regression (C = 1.0) on the 12 primary pre-contact features; frozen in Phase 3
ranking_score: log-odds (decision function) of the uncalibrated logistic regression
reference_distribution: ranking scores of the validation period (Apr - May 2009), 4977 leads

calibration.method: Platt: logistic regression on the model's log-odds

test_calibration_drift: test period mean calibrated probability 14.7% vs actual 30.8% (reports/metrics.json)
limitations: Ranking is a historical association, not guaranteed conversion.
Probability calibration drifts with the overall conversion rate; recalibrate on recent outcomes before use.
Trained on one Portuguese bank's 2008-2009 campaigns.
explanation: closed-form linear SHAP: coef * (x - mean of transformed development background); equals shap.LinearExplainer with an independent masker on the Phase 4 background

app_outputs.historical_reference_priority: band from the frozen validation-period cutoffs
app_outputs.historical_percentile: share of validation-period (Apr - May 2009) reference leads at or below
app_outputs.batch_priority / batch_percentile: same 20/30/50 rule applied within the uploaded batch
app_outputs.historical_calibrated_estimate: secondary; Platt calibration fitted Apr - May 2009; drifted later

rules: earlier_campaign_contacts == 0  <=>  previous_campaign_outcome == 'nonexistent' (holds for every row of the audited data)
earlier_calls_this_campaign = campaign - 1 (the source field counts the call being scored)
